top_fixes: Give the hook a plain human stake within the first 4 seconds, on screen if not spoken: what a wrong set costs (wasted reps, a tweaked back). Right now non-tech viewers see a red STOP but no reason to care, and that is where the mass group leaves.

Make beats 6-8 lean harder on the body and less on the wave. Keep the spoken lines short and let the green ghost over the real rep carry the meaning; 'seventeen joints' and 'one dip in a wave' back to back is where six of sixteen personas drop.

Cut on-screen text to one idea per beat. Beats 12, 13 and 14 each stack three or four text elements (numbers, labels, corner tag, source line), and at phone size and 1.15x nobody reads them all; the 122 vs 53 pair should be alone on screen.

Earn the Salesforce turn with one bridging phrase inside beat 14 that ties this project to the job, for example that checking an AI's judgement is the skill being hired for. Without it the ending reads as a separate reel, and the builders, who are the best audience, are the ones who notice.

Pick one primary ask. Send (beat 13), comment FORM (corner tag) and follow (beat 15) compete; keep the spoken send line, make FORM visible long enough to read, and let the follow ride only on the final frame.
